evidence.quote: The investment case is that India is outsourcing manufacturing at an accelerating pace, and PGEL has become one of the few companies capable of acting as an end-to-end manufacturing partner for major brands.
PGEL manufactures plastic parts, sheet metal components, tooling, heat exchangers, copper tubing, controllers, PCB assemblies and other critical inputs in-house.
The company is simultaneously investing in refrigerator manufacturing, washing machine capacity, RAC expansion, plastics, South India expansion, Greater Noida expansion, West India AC campus.
PGEL is not a consumer brand. It manufactures for brands.
The company has evolved into a diversified manufacturing platform serving multiple categories rather than relying on a single product line.
The current capex cycle may temporarily suppress return ratios, but it also raises barriers to entry.
FY25 consolidated revenue reached approximately ₹4,870 crore, representing about 77% YoY growth.
Management's FY26 guidance is equally important: ₹5,700–5,800 Cr.
